method: 수동 크롭 (PyMuPDF clip 렌더 300 dpi) — 본문 그림 = 임베드 래스터 1 장씩 → clip = 래스터 bbox 그대로. SI 표 = 표 틀 래스터 + 글자 → 표 제목 줄부터 아래 괘선 + 2 pt. SI Fig. S3 · S4 는 래스터 bbox 가 캡션 윗줄과 몇 pt 겹치지만 겹친 부분은 그림 쪽 여백이라 bbox 그대로 (렌더에 캡션 글자 없음 확인).

figures.caption: Figure 1. a) XRD patterns of pristine SC-Ni90 and sulfurized SC-Ni90-S. b–d) magnified images of three regions in a).

Figure 2. a) TEM image of SC-Ni90 particle. b,c) HRTEM images of the surface region of SC-Ni90. d) Diffraction pattern of SC-Ni90. e–i) STEM dark-field image and EDS mappings of a SC-Ni90 particle. j) TEM image of SC-Ni90-0.2%S. k,l) Surface lattice structure of SC-Ni90-0.2%S. m) Diffraction pattern of SC-Ni90-0.2%S. n–s) STEM dark-field image and EDS mappings of a SC-Ni90-0.2%S particle.

Figure 3. a–c) Charge/discharge profiles of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S in Sulfide ASSBs at various rates. d) Rate performance of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S in Sulfide ASSBs. e) CV curves of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S at 0.05 mV s−1 in Sulfide ASSBs. f) Cycling performance of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S in Sulfide ASSBs at 0.3 C.

Figure 4. a–c) Charge/discharge profiles of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S in Sulfide ASSBs at various cycles. d) Long cycling performance of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S in Sulfide ASSBs at 1 C. e–g) Nyquist plots of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S in Sulfide ASSBs at various cycles.

Figure 5. a–c) Charge/discharge profiles of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S at various mass loadings in Sulfide ASSBs. d–f) Relationship of the areal capacity and the mass loading. g–i) Discharge capacity of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S.
Figure 6. a–c) CV curves of SC-Ni90 and SC-Ni90-S in sulfide ASSBs at various scan rates. d) Relationship of the peak current (ip) in CV and the square root of the scan rate (v1/2).
